rule: Technical correctness alone does not pass. A reply that only repeats a record without answering the practical question FAILS USEFULNESS.

canonicalExample.question: How many other used cars are on the lot?
canonicalExample.fail: Repeats the one observed vehicle (even if that vehicle description is accurate).
pass: states physical lot total is UNKNOWN
states website count separately if available
does not equate website inventory with physical presence
suggests how AION can determine the real count

scoringNotes: Score real Owner-facing reply text only. Do not reward verbosity. Mean >= 3.5 and zero fail flags required for conversational pass.
